purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Kota Madiun's official ATR/BPN land-office site evidences local cadastral measurement and mapping custody. ATR/BPN BHUMI publicly documents bidang tanah layers and parcel lookup concepts, but the reviewed public landing/documentation route and bounded anonymous requests did not produce a safe native parcel identifier plus polygon. No sample GeoJSON was retained; runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: The local registry/cadastre custodian is Kantor Pertanahan Kota Madiun under ATR/BPN, evidenced by its official subdomain and a 2025 report naming its cadastral measurement and mapping section. The Madiun city SmartMap material is municipal PBB/P2 tax-map context, not evidence of an open cadastral vector service.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official 2025 report identifies the Kantor Pertanahan Kota Madiun and its measurement and cadastral-mapping section in a land-area discrepancy facilitation meeting. It exposes no safe parcel geometry endpoint.
Official BHUMI help page states that the interactive map is integrated with ATR/BPN's ATLAS geospatial platform.
Official help material documents bidang tanah map layers and searches by NIB, HAK or NIBEL; it does not publish a stable anonymous feature endpoint or promise unrestricted parcel downloads.
City government report describes coordination with BPN on land-data synchronization and digital certificates; it is supporting custody context, not parcel geometry evidence.
